capabilities: Wrap selected text in custom tags
Merge old shortcuts on first enable
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.14.0 or later. On first enable, it can merge shortcuts from the original plugin.
intentEvidence: This repository is a fork of Obsidian Wrap With Shortcuts.
motivation: To upgrade and rewrite the original plugin with a declarative API so changes no longer require restarting Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to quickly wrap selected text in custom tags such as underline, sub, or ruby.
